title: Claude Duet - AI jo pehle aapko message karta hai
content:
Ab tak aap AI ko message karte the. Ab AI aapko PEHLE message karega.
Anthropic just launched Claude Duet.
Claude Duet ek naya app hai jahan Claude ek proactive agent ki tarah kaam karta hai.
Aap chat kholo, uska wait nahi karta.
It comes to you with what needs your attention.
Ye professionals aur small business owners ke liye banaya gaya hai.
Har subah ye ek short brief bhejta hai, aapke connected apps se.
Gmail, Slack, calendar, sab dekh ke batata hai kya important hai.
Anthropic ke hisaab se ye Claude Marketplace ke 6,000 se zyada connectors aur plugins use kar sakta hai.
Aur ye Claude Opus 5.5 ke around design kiya gaya hai.
Aur ek badi baat.
Iske paas apna virtual machine aur apna browser hai.
Matlab aap laptop band kar do, kaam chalta rehta hai.
You get a notification when the task is done or needs your review.
Par mujhe sabse achha part kuch aur laga.
Message bhejne se pehle, payment karne se pehle, document sign karne se pehle, ya kuch delete karne se pehle...
ye aapko exactly dikhata hai ki kya karne wala hai, aur aapki approval ka wait karta hai.
Aur kuch cheezein approval ke saath bhi off-limits hain, jaise securities trade karna ya accounts ke beech paisa move karna.
That is how an agent should be designed.
Abhi ye waitlist pe hai, aur sirf US ke Pro aur Max subscribers ke liye.
Toh India mein abhi seedha nahi milega.
Toh aap aaj kya kar sakte ho?
Same idea apne kaam mein lagao.
Ek list banao: kaunse kaam AI khud kar sakta hai, aur kaunse kaam pe human approval chahiye.
Reading and drafting can be automatic. Sending and paying should need a yes from you.
Mera take simple hai... AI agents ka future "auto" nahi, "auto plus approval" hai.
Official announcement chahiye? Comment DUET and I'll DM you the link.
Follow karo, roz ka AI update yahin milega.
